svg.title: ChipLab
svg.desc: AI agents that design chips, check open hardware and software against their specs, and send the fixes upstream. 47 fixes merged upstream, 63 of our bug reports fixed by maintainers, 244 fixes in review, drawn as a wafer map where each die is one record. The chip: Numerics done; RTL + verification done; FPGA bit-exact done; Sign-off now; Tapeout next.
svg.text: AI agents that design chips, check open hardware and
software against their specs, and send the fixes upstream.

text.tspan: of our bug reports fixed by maintainers
